profile_text.body:
Humane Intelligence is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2022 and based in Katy, Texas. According to its website, the organization is dedicated to breaking down barriers to AI deployment for social good. It describes itself as collaboratively designing and running rigorous evaluations that make AI systems more accountable, responsible, and fair.

The organization offers three main services. AI red teaming is a semi-structured testing approach to assess and improve the safety and effectiveness of AI models and systems by identifying vulnerabilities, limitations, and potential areas for improvement, offered as a paid service using the organization's own software, which it plans to release under an open source software license in 2026. AI Contextual Evaluations are rigorous, mixed-method, bespoke evaluations designed to give comprehensive analysis of an AI model or system's performance for a specified problem space. The organization is rapidly developing its knowledge graph and ontological AI problem space mapping capabilities in 2026. Bias bounties are collaboratively designed sets of challenges that bring together researchers, impacted communities, and domain experts to examine and improve AI and ML systems, models, and datasets. Humane Intelligence closed its final self-hosted bias bounty in November 2025 and is working to move its bias bounty program onto Zindi, a global data science challenge platform, in 2026.
